uncited: Initialize the energy accumulator to zero.
Iterate over every voxel $(i,j,k)$ in the grid bounds $[0, I-1] \times [0, J-1] \times [0, K-1]$.

For each voxel, identify the 8 neighbors in its 3x3 neighborhood $N(x_{i,j,k})$ by applying offsets $\delta_i, \delta_j \in \{-1, 0, 1\}$ where $(\delta_i, \delta_j) \neq (0,0)$, while keeping the $k$-index fixed.
For each valid neighbor $(i+\delta_i, j+\delta_j, k)$ within grid boundaries, compute the absolute difference $|x_{i+\delta_i, j+\delta_j, k} - x_{i,j,k}|$.
Accumulate the absolute differences into the energy value.
The following computes the SAD energy $h(\mathbf{x})$ for a 3D grid $\mathbf{x}$ of dimensions $I \times J \times K$.
